name: Front-left tire inflation pressure
caveats: Requires direct TPMS and accessible OEM interface

name: Brake-fluid reservoir warning/level
caveats: Do not assume continuous percent/volume; warning may be binary

name: Brake hydraulic control pressure
caveats: Neither pressure nor its absence verifies brake safety

name: Engine coolant temperature
caveats: Useful trend + warning; temperature alone cannot identify cause

name: Engine cooling fan actual speed
caveats: A PWM fan command is not actual fan RPM

name: Vehicle speed
caveats: Vehicle speed helps add context for cooling diagnosis

name: 12 V / ECU supply voltage
retrieval_path: Mode 01 PID 42 is CONTROL MODULE voltage; OEM battery values may differ
caveats: Do not label module voltage as exact battery-post voltage

name: Engine rotational speed during crank
retrieval_path: OEM logging or high-rate OBD RPM
caveats: Generic OBD polling may miss the cranking event

name: Current through starter motor
retrieval_path: possibly inferred from battery current; direct measurement unverified
caveats: IBS battery current is not necessarily starter current; PHEV auxiliary path differs

name: Cylinder misfire counters
retrieval_path: OEM values or Mode 06 if ECU exposes relevant tests
caveats: Counters, standardized trouble codes and monitor data differ

name: Fuel system pressure
retrieval_path: Mode 01 PID 0A or other rail PID if supported; otherwise OEM
caveats: Distinguish low-side from high-side pressure: not interchangeable

name: Mass airflow estimate or sensor reading
hardware_basis: hot-film air mass and engine model
caveats: DME may substitute modeled values after sensor faults
